chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: The funeral at Waters AME Church and Ella's song
summary: McRae thinks he played "My Buddy" on tenor at the service and hopes to get Baltimore newspaper photographs.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: There's some things here about the funeral at Waters AME Church. And Ella was asked to sing a song. She tried to sing My Buddy and it didn't work out too well. Do you recall that?
I guess it was some sort of a memorial.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

I played 'My Buddy,' I think. I think I played 'My Buddy' on tenor. That's what I wanted to get for you. I want to get those for you. From the Baltimore paper -- the library down there. They got some pictures -- all the pictures of the funeral and the things that we did. I think I played 'My Buddy.' I don't really remember what she sang. She didn sing something. I can't recall it, it's very vague.
